scope: Exploratory observed-panel ANCOVA point rankings with original eligible cost menu. Within-stratum policy contrasts cancel the common control level. Baseline/block WLS and village-CR1 inference are distinct from assignment-weighted ratio estimands and finite protection. Eligibility is baseline-defined; identified follow-up diets still select this sample. Theta is stipulated total welfare weight, not measured preferences. Switches have sampling and specification uncertainty; no full-target ranking, new externality or general-interest importance is established.
